## CONVERSATION
Concierge: Hi Sarah! Welcome to Shiftsmart.
Partner: The shifts are too far for me since I take the bus. Can I change my transportation to bus rider?

## CONCIERGE OUTPUT
Try picking up multiple shifts at the same store on the same day so you only take the bus once. You'll earn more that way. Check the Shifts tab to see what else that store has open.
